title: 작문
intro: and neither + 동사 + 주어 / … not … either

items.ko: 나는 그 책을 안 읽었고, 그녀도 안 읽었다.
answers: nor has she read the book
and neither has she read it
and neither has she read the book
and she hasn't read it either
and she hasn't read the book either
items.why: 부정문 뒤라서 nor has she예요. and neither has she, and she hasn't either도 맞아요.

items.ko: 그는 생선을 안 먹고, 고기도 안 먹는다.
answers: and neither does he eat meat
and he doesn't eat meat either
items.why: 일반동사 eat이라 does를 앞으로 보내요. nor does he eat meat예요.

answers: and so do i play the piano
items.why: 긍정문 뒤 '~도 그렇다'는 and so do I예요. 일반동사 plays라 do를 써요.

items.ko: 우리는 오래 있을 수 없고, 그들도 오래 있을 수 없다.
answers: and neither can they stay long
and they can't stay long either
items.why: 부정문 뒤, 조동사 can이라 nor can they예요.

items.ko: A: 나 배고파.  B: 나도 그래.
items.why: be동사(I'm = I am)라서 So am I예요. Me too도 맞아요.

items.sentence: A: I didn't do my homework.  B: ___.
items.ko: A: 나 숙제 안 했어.  B: 나도 안 했어.
items.why: 부정문 뒤, 과거 일반동사라 Nor did I(= Neither did I)예요. I didn't either도 맞아요.

items.sentence: She has never been to Japan, ___.
items.ko: 그녀는 일본에 가 본 적이 없고, 중국에도 가 본 적이 없다.
answers: nor has she been to china
and neither has she been to china
and she hasn't been to china either
and she has never been to china either
items.why: never가 든 부정문이에요. 동사가 has been 두 개라 has만 앞으로: nor has she been to China예요.
A도 B도 아니다는 neither A nor B예요. Neither Tom nor Mina was at home.

items.ko: 그 계획은 싸지 않았고, 쉽지도 않았다.
items.why: be동사 was라서 nor was it easy예요.

items.sentence: They will come to the party, ___.
items.ko: 그들은 파티에 올 거고, 우리도 올 것이다.
answers: and we will come to the party too
items.why: 긍정문 뒤, 조동사 will이라 and so will we예요.
